# Test fixtures

Everything in this folder is invented for tests: the people, usernames, clubs, books and
repositories do not exist. Nothing here is bundled into the app.

- `two-city.json`, `hours-ledger.json`, `decision-journal.json`: documents in the cross-app contract shapes.
- `goodreads.csv`, `storygraph.csv`: the column layouts of the two book exports.
- `lichess.ndjson`, `chesscom-2025-06.json`, `chesscom-archives.json`: the response shapes of the two chess APIs.
- `github-contents.json`, `github-commits.json`: the response shapes of the GitHub REST API.
- `year-in-data.json`: a backup of this app with a fictional birthday (10 March), books and builds.
